name: observability-design
description: Design comprehensive logging, metrics, and distributed tracing systems that provide complete visibility into system behavior, enable rapid incident detection and resolution, and support data-driven operational decisions across distributed architectures.
inputs: Service dependency maps and data flow diagrams
Compliance and regulatory requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, PCI-DSS)
Business KPIs and critical user journeys
Team size, expertise, and on-call structure
outputs: Observability architecture document with three-pillar design (logs, metrics, traces)
Logging strategy with structured format, aggregation, and retention policies
Metrics framework with SLI/SLO definitions and RED/USE metrics
Distributed tracing design with sampling strategy and instrumentation standards
Alerting and notification strategy with severity levels and escalation policies
Dashboard and visualization design for multiple audiences
Implementation roadmap with phased rollout plan
Data governance framework with compliance controls
Cost management plan with optimization strategies
estimated_time: 4-8 weeks for comprehensive design and implementation
